note.zh: 第四阶段由隐藏事件 arcsite.1015 等权随机选其一：已有 fire/politics/genes 任一考古标记时排除对应其他结果；1018 另在已获 ocean_tech 标记（1010 选项 b：花费400能量研究有毒海带）时被排除（events/arcsite_events.txt:157-205）。
note.en: Stage 4 runs hidden arcsite.1015, which draws one at equal weight; the archaeology flags fire/politics/genes exclude the others, and 1018 is also excluded if ocean_tech was earned from 1010 option b (400 energy for Toxic Kelp) (events/arcsite_events.txt:157-205).

notes.zh: 审阅说明：遗址定义带有生成权重（冰冻星球30、寒冷宜居星球5，max_instances = 1），也可在星系生成时出现；知名领袖纳苏兹·德墨忒尔的“虚空之语”只在该遗址尚未被发现时把它放到我们境内。
notes.en: Review note: the site has a spawn weight (30 on frozen worlds, 5 on cold habitable ones, max_instances = 1), so it can appear at galaxy generation; Nasuz Demetor's 'Voices in the Void' only places it in our space while it has not been found.

scope.zh: 整条故事：遗址定义与五个阶段、1015 随机分派（hub+桥接）、三个互斥结果与第五阶段、掷骰失败事件。
scope.en: Whole story: site definition and five stages, the 1015 dispatcher (hub + bridges), the three exclusive results and stage 5, roll-failure events.

uncertain: Generic dig incidents (ancrel.8000-8070, 13030) are shared hubs in archaeology-incidents and only linked.
